description:
Found by s507d while checking what `-E` enables.  perl 5.40.3:
  perl -E 'say __SUB__ // "undef"'     -> undef
  pcl  -E 'say __SUB__ // "undef"'     -> __SUB__
  printf 'use feature "current_sub";\nprint __SUB__ // "undef", "\n";\nmy $f = sub { __SUB__ }; print ref($f->()), "\n";\n' > sub1.pl
  perl sub1.pl -> undef / CODE;   pcl sub1.pl -> __SUB__ / CODE
Not switch-specific (the file form shows the same).  At file level __SUB__ with the feature on is undef (perlfunc: "outside of a subroutine, __SUB__ returns undef").  The docs for -E do not list __SUB__ among its features until this is fixed.


=== DONE (s507c, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-05) ===
MEASURED: _rewrite_current_sub (Pl/Parser.pm) rewrote __SUB__ only inside a named or anonymous sub; with no owner the word stayed a bareword (the string "__SUB__"), and `defined(__SUB__)` died in pl-__SUB__ (base, s4.pl).  PROBED: perl answers undef for __SUB__ in a STRING EVAL's text too, even when the eval sits in a sub (s10.pl: undef/undef/undef) -- not-supported.md's "perl resolves it to the sub containing the eval" was wrong.
FIX: with no owner, __SUB__ becomes `scalar(undef)` when CORE::-spelled, or when the feature is on at the word -- `feature_regions_of($doc, 'current_sub')` (threshold 5.15), the unicode_strings region reader generalised (one reader, `feature_at`), or in an eval text when the eval SITE had it (`current_sub` joins the eval site's feature list, so it is part of the eval cache key; it is filtered out of the PPI seed).  Without the feature the word stays the bareword it is in perl.  An AUTOQUOTED __SUB__ (`__SUB__ => 1`, `$h{__SUB__}`) is never rewritten, in a sub either (that half was wrong on the base: CODE(0x1) as a hash key); `_token_autoquoted` is now the one test, shared with _reclassify_bare_vwords.
PROBES (scratch/s507c/m3b/s1-s11, sub1): file-level with the feature, CORE::__SUB__ without it, use v5.16, :5.40 + __SUB__->() (dies in both; perl's text differs, error text is not a goal), eval text at file level and inside a sub, autoquote at file level and in a sub, -E.  All = perl except the die TEXT of undef->().
GUARDS: Pl/t/misc-fixes-02.t +1 row (six claims in one program; FAILS on the base), Pl/t/pcl-switches-01.t "-E: __SUB__ outside any sub is undef" (fails on the base).  docs/not-supported.md's __SUB__ entry rewritten (residue: inside a sub, a bare __SUB__ is rewritten even without the feature); docs/pcl-commands.md lists __SUB__ among -E's features.
BARS (7bc12f4c): companion op/current_sub.t 8/3 -> 10/1 (the use v5.15 row needed the 5.15 threshold), spliced; gate PASS 279/9758; sweep TOTAL 18731 +0.
subject: LOW (found by s507d, on main 50dbd195): `__SUB__` outside any sub is the STRING "__SUB__" under PCL (perl: undef) -- `pcl -E 'say __SUB__ // "undef"'` prints __SUB__; also in a file with `use feature "current_sub"`; inside an anon sub it is right
